answers.question: Hallsberg (`740000077`): withheld: OSM joins no footway to the platforms and tags no entrance
answers.answer: Partly answered. OSM has platforms 1, 2, 3 and 5a, a 188 m footbridge (w9891871) over the tracks and two stairs down from it, one to platform 1/2 and one to platform 3/5a. It also has three entrance nodes on Västra Storgatan. Länstrafiken lists tracks 1, 3, 5a and 5b. Jernhusen confirms an accessible entrance from the track side into the waiting room. No source found mentions a lift or ramp to the island platforms.
